At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an '''Iyra''' with at least five [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]] was suspended in a cage at a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] known as [[Shilley's]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Questal/Legends|Questal]]. In one instance, the [[Iyra]] wore a [[Clothing/Legends|brassiere]] around its trunk and dangled another from a tentacle stretched through the bars of the cage.<ref name="CAV5" />

==Behind the scenes==
The caged Iyra appears in an illustration by [[Andrew Bates]] and [[Ramón Pérez]] for the adventure ''[[The Game Chambers of Questal]]''.<ref name="CAV5" /> Although the adventure was first published in [[1990]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' line,<ref name="GC">''[[The Game Chambers of Questal]]''</ref> the illustration is unique to the revised version published as part of ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Five]]'' in [[1998]].<ref name="CAV5" />
